chunks: There is no journey more far-reaching in its effect upon flesh, blood, skin, or hair than the journey to Makkah, and no one reaches it without hardship overtaking him.

key_terms.أَبْلَغُ: more intense or more far-reaching in effect

ai.seo_question: Why is the journey to Makkah described as especially difficult in hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the physical strain and exertion involved in the journey to Makkah. It highlights the hardship bound up with hajj travel, underscoring the weight and merit of this act of worship.
